title: What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $\pi_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K
abstract: arXiv:2610.37917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026

translated_title: 什么才是真正重要的？π₀.₅ 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上推理设置的配对评估
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用家庭机器人提供了一个有前景的范式。然而，在较小规模环境中部署的推理和数据收集策略不一定能泛化到大规模、多样化的任务套件中。为弥补这一空白，我们对先前提出的推理和数据收集策略在全部 100 个任务上进行了系统性的配对评估。我们的评估使用基于 2025 年 BEHAVIOR 挑战赛冠军方案微调的 π₀.₅ 模型，该模型在公开测试集上达到了 0.39 的 Q 分数。这些结果表明，所提出的策略并不能一致地迁移到新的环境和任务中。
tldr: 该论文通过对基于 2025 年 BEHAVIOR 挑战赛冠军微调的 π₀.₅ 模型在 BEHAVIOR-1K 全部 100 个任务上进行系统性配对评估，揭示了以往在小规模场景中有效的推理与数据收集策略并不能一致地泛化到大规模多样化任务环境中。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic paired evaluation of inference and data-collection strategies for a fine-tuned π₀.₅ model across all 100 BEHAVIOR-1K tasks, revealing that previously proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks.
